description: Error code -> repair rules and hint templates. A new error code only needs one more entry here; repair-executor.ps1 never changes. Conversely, the script itself no longer contains any error-code literal.
defaultHint: Unrecognised error code: look it up in section 4 of docs/script-standards.md by the error message.

fixerRules.description: File/directory does not exist: find the missing absolute path in the .robin, relocate it when exactly one same-named item exists (R1), or create the directory under PadRoot (R2)
fixerRules.messagePattern: not found|找不到|does not exist|不存在

hintRules.hint: SAP element/session error: screen numbers and element IDs change with the transaction code, so check by hand whether the findById paths in the business script match the current SAP version.
UI/window error: first check whether the window title was changed; otherwise insert a "wait for window to appear" before the failing action and raise the timeout. Do not rely on coordinate clicks.

Excel error: usually the file is still locked, a protected-view window is still open, or the COM instance attached to a different Excel process; check close_excel.log and the Excel process count first.
Clipboard error: the previous copy did not succeed. Check whether the source window really had focus and whether Ctrl+A landed on the right control.
File error: check the path escaping in the .robin (PAD needs double backslashes), whether the directory exists, and whether another program is holding the file.
Directory error: check that the directory exists and that the current account can write to it.
System error: mostly a timeout or insufficient permissions. Check the external script's maximum wait and whether SAP/Excel is blocked by a dialog.
Script error: the external VBS/Python process returned non-zero. Look at extraLogs below; the VBS log or the Python stdout usually carries the real reason.
External command failed: look at extraLogs below (VBS log / Python stdout) to work out what the exit code means.
